name: skillwiki
description: Project-aware Karpathy-style knowledge base: 21 prompt-only skills (wiki-*, proj-*, using-skillwiki, skillwiki-mcp) backed by HTTP MCP wiki_capture.

SKILLWIKI_MCP_TOKEN.title: SkillWiki HTTP MCP bearer
SKILLWIKI_MCP_TOKEN.description: Bearer for https://wiki.karldigi.dev/mcp. Same SKILLWIKI_MCP_TOKEN used by Grok CLI. Never put the value in plugin files.

SKILLWIKI_EXTRA_VAULTS.title: SkillWiki extra vault ids
SKILLWIKI_EXTRA_VAULTS.description: Optional comma-separated extra vault ids (example: wiki-fin). Non-secret. Same connector URL https://wiki.karldigi.dev/mcp. Default central stays on. Server allowed_vaults is the security boundary; listing an extra here does not authorize it. Do not put a bearer in this field.
